_comment: Bundle composition (plan robot-installer B1c). Paths are relative to this file unless absolute. A component is copied by an explicit list: anything unnamed - bin/ also holds auth.json, the encryption key, *.enc, gateway.jsonc, opencode.jsonc, locks/, .opencode/ - never reaches the bundle. Reference for layout and contents: universal-search/build_portable.ps1 and its output d:/!Smit/Smit2 (owner, 2026-10-07: «используй то что уже сделано как реф»). Rebranding to smit comes later.
